title: The Twine for a Torn Parcel
youtube_title: The Twine for a Torn Parcel | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Helping without being asked is a quiet sort of brave.
summary: At a harbor step where parcels change hands, a parcel whose twine had given up is awkward for one person. Ximena notices Papa struggling and takes a useful half of the job without asking to be praised.
